title: fix(storage): the upload-link page speaks the request's language, and its refusals read as page copy
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DKMkvWZdqZ8XFcrT6arhCKt)_

Refs #32712 (item a)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：代理用 `create_upload_link` 发给用户的上传页面，现在按请求的语言显示（浏览器 `Accept-Language`，没有时用工作区默认语言，再没有就是英文），平台语言表上的 11 种语言都有译文；上传后页面显示的拒绝原因（记录被审批锁定、字段只读、文件太大等）也改成页面自己的、同一语言的句子，由服务器放在 `error.userMessage` 里返回。
- 为什么改：中文部署里用户打开链接看到的是整页英文；审批锁定的拒绝还带着 `RECORD_LOCKED:` 前缀和记录标题，只读字段的拒绝直接写出对象和字段的 API 名，和页面「不点名记录、字段」的设计（#30892）相冲突。
- 风险与回滚：只动上传链接这一对 GET/PUT 门和它的页面；`error.code`、成功响应体不变，`error.message` 仍是诊断用英文（只去掉生产者自己的代码前缀，与 `/api/v1/data` 一致）；工作区默认语言经平台唯一的 `resolveLocalizationContext` 读取，读不到就用英文。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-storage/src/upload-link-copy.ts`（译文表与「拒绝码到页面句子」的映射）、`storage-routes.ts`（`uploadLinkCopyFor` 的语言顺序与 `relayUploadLinkRefusal`）、`upload-link-page.ts`（页面与脚本读 `userMessage`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage exec vitest run src/record-file-access.integration.test.ts src/upload-link-copy.test.ts -t "#32712"`，预期 13 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One package, `@objectstack/service-storage`. No new export, error code, route, query parameter or wire field: `userMessage` is the existing optional member of the error envelope (`ApiErrorSchema.userMessage`).

- **The page's language (`storage-routes.ts`, `storage-service-plugin.ts`).** Both upload-link doors pick the language once per request: the request's `Accept-Language` (read with the platform's `preferredLocaleFromHeader`), else the workspace default for the signed-in caller, else English. The workspace default is the `localization` settings for the caller's organization and user, read through `resolveLocalizationContext`, the resolver every authenticated door's execution context uses; `composeStorageRoutes` binds it, so the plugin's mount and the host door (`mountStorageRoutes`) both get it. A default that cannot be read is no default. The doors still read no query parameter, so `?locale` is not a source here.
- **The sentences (`upload-link-copy.ts`, new).** Every sentence the page shows, for each language on the platform locale table (`PLATFORM_LOCALES`), keyed and read like Setup's storage test answer (`storage-test-copy.ts`). The two now share one reader, `copy-locale.ts` (moved out of `storage-test-copy.ts`; `storageTestCopyLocaleOf` keeps its name and answers). The expiry is written with `Intl.DateTimeFormat` in the page's language, still in UTC and saying so.
- **The page (`upload-link-page.ts`).** The page's `lang` and `dir` attributes follow the language (`ar` is right-to-left). The script's status lines arrive as a JSON literal escaped for an inline script. After an upload it shows `error.userMessage`, or the page's own "the upload failed" when the answer carries none; it no longer shows `error.message`.
- **The refusals (`relayUploadLinkRefusal` and the PUT door's own refusals).** Each refusal now carries `userMessage`: a text the producer itself marked for the user (`declaredUserMessage`), verbatim; else the page's sentence for the code (`AUTH_REQUIRED`, `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`, `ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `FIELD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`, `RECORD_LOCKED`, `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, any `503`); else the producer's text behind a localized "the upload was refused" lead-in. None of the page's sentences names a record, object or field. `error.message` keeps the producer's wording with its own code prefix stripped by `withoutDeclaredCodePrefix`, the `/api/v1/data` door's rule, so the record lock's `RECORD_LOCKED: …` no longer leads it.
- **Route ledger notes** for the two doors say so.

## Why

The card (#32712, triage 6822323217): a zh-CN deployment hands out an English-only page; ruling C on #32440 (program #32654) has text addressed to a person composed by its producer in the request's language. Note 6830733775 (contract review of PR #32779, N1) adds the refusals the page shows since #32734: the lock refusal reached the page with its code prefix and the record's title, and the read-only refusal named object and field by API name.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, untouched: naming the record and the field on the page (the #30892 privacy choice; needs a maintainer ruling). This PR removes no ruling: the page's own sentences name nothing, as its header always said. The refusals that used to carry a record title or `object.field` were the exception, and now read as page copy.
- The fallback limb shows the producer's text verbatim behind a localized lead-in, so a refusal the page has no sentence for (an app's validation rule, `VALIDATION_FAILED`) keeps telling the person why, in the producer's language. A producer that marks its own `userMessage` is shown as written.
- The `GET` door's `401 AUTH_REQUIRED` is still the JSON envelope a browser shows raw (it now carries a localized `userMessage` too). Turning it into a page is not this card.
- `storage-test-copy.ts` changes only by delegating to the shared reader; its exports and answers are the same (`storage-test-locale.test.ts` green).
- Step 0 on `main` `c04aa295`: the page took no request input, and neither upload-link door read `Accept-Language`, `?locale` or a settings value (`grep -ci "accept-language|locale"` over `storage-routes.ts` and `upload-link-page.ts`: 0 and 0). Rendered, the picker page was `lang="en"`, "Upload a file … It stops working at Thu, 12 Nov 2026 22:00:00 GMT." whatever the request or the workspace said.

## Tests

- `record-file-access.integration.test.ts`, new `#32712` block, through the real routes on the real plugin (sqlite `:memory:`), with a `settings` service answering the workspace's `localization.locale` and announcing changes: the picker page in zh-CN (lang, every sentence, the expiry, no record/object/field/user named); workspace default when the request names no language, the request's language winning over it, English with neither; the unusable page and the PUT's unusable and sign-in refusals; the record lock and the `readonlyWhen` refusal (the page's sentence, no `RECORD_LOCKED` prefix, nothing named); the upload limit in the workspace default with the link still usable; the page script's status lines in zh-CN showing the door's `userMessage`.
- Existing pins updated: the lock refusal's `message` no longer starts with `RECORD_LOCKED`; the page shows `userMessage`, and an answer with none shows "The upload failed." rather than the diagnostic.
- `upload-link-copy.test.ts`, new: every platform locale has every sentence; no non-English entry repeats an English sentence; English unchanged; locale reading (aliases, regions, fallback); each code's sentence; the expiry format.

## Verification

All readings on head `4f6a91d1d8` (branch tip after one `git merge origin/main`; the merge brought two `ui/` commits and nothing under `packages/services/`), after a whole-tree `turbo run build`.

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage test`: 79 files, 1484 tests passed (taken on `6324ca39`+tests, before the `main` merge, which touched no storage path).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage typecheck` (tsc, scripts tsconfig, `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- Focused: `vitest run src/record-file-access.integration.test.ts src/upload-link-copy.test.ts -t "#32712"`: 13 passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor hit 1 to 0, blob restored equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

The suite imports `src/` directly, so no rebuild sits between mutation and run.

- A1, `relayUploadLinkRefusal` keeps the producer's prefix (`withoutDeclaredCodePrefix(e.message, err)` replaced by `e.message`): 2 red, the lock refusal's `message` starts `RECORD_LOCKED` (the #32734 pin and the new #32712 pin).
- A2, the relay sends the producer's text as `userMessage` (`uploadLinkRefusalText(…)` replaced by `message`): 4 red (unusable/sign-in, lock, read-only, upload limit).
- A3, the workspace default wins over the request's language: 6 red.
- A4, the page script shows `error.message` instead of `error.userMessage`: 2 red.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: "75 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 75 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Every family exited 0. Two (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`) exited 3 on a first pass before the whole-tree build, and 0 after it on this head.
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0.
- The run record is in the project files as `server-seat5/32712/gates-ran-4f6a91d1.txt`.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
